name: Two In One Manufacturing, Inc.
old_description: Two In One Manufacturing is dedicated to customer solutions and satisfaction offering quality work and product at a competitive price with high quality, quick turnaround and on-time delivery. As a sub-contract manufacturer, we provide a wide range of services to an array of clients. Our team can support every stage of a customer’s project development. We can provide design, labor, or order fulfillment of high mix low-high volume with quick turn services of lead times varying from one day to 4 weeks with a flexible supply chain. Our services are ideal for clients whose products are too complex for smaller contract manufacturers, clients whose volume does not meet the requirements for larger manufacturing providers from overseas, or simply a customer who needs more collaboration in the early stages of new product development. We give our customers full transparency and completely open communication to provide the best customer service from quote to plan, build test, and delivery. Our current customer base is built from continuous returning clients and referrals from our loyal customers due to our focus on continuous improvement and customer satisfaction.
about:
Two In One Manufacturing, Inc. operates from Nashua, New Hampshire, where it was founded in 1989 as a wire harness assembly business. The company is woman- and minority-owned, located in a HUBZone with small disadvantaged business status.

As a sub-contract manufacturer, the firm provides engineering and manufacturing assembly services across two divisions: General Assembly, Precision Assembly, Military Class Production, and Cables Production. It employs approximately 75 full-time manufacturing workers in a facility that includes 35,000 square feet of production space, 4,500 square feet of storage, and 1,700 square feet of office and cafeteria area. The operation handles high-mix, low-to-high volume work with lead times ranging from one day to four weeks, supported by a flexible supply chain and kanban capabilities.

The customer base spans automotive, industrial renewable energy, military defense and homeland security, medical, aerospace, RF microwave assemblies, telecommunications, instrumentation, semiconductor, and industrial equipment sectors. Clients range from companies whose products are too complex for smaller contract manufacturers to those whose volumes fall below the thresholds of large overseas providers, as well as customers needing early-stage collaboration on new product development.

The company emphasizes continuous improvement and customer satisfaction, citing full transparency and open communication from quote through delivery. Its quality policy targets on-time delivery of quality products at competitive prices, with ISO 9001:2015, ITAR registration, IPC compliance, and RoHS compliance underpinning its processes.
